candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order to return 502 and gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side spans/logs absent; whether payment is slow vs unreachable is not directly observed. Inventory/redis path is healthy.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory/redis succeeding while payment POST /v1/authorizations errors with transport ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to order and checkout; gateway logs and metrics confirm ~2s 502s on /v1/checkout. Payment-side telemetry is missing to fully bound the cause.
